en: Multi-view postcard showing interiors and exterior of a spa/sanatorium complex called Sanatorium-Volksbad in the Stadtpark. Images include the main facade, dining hall, reading room, guest rooms, and therapeutic bathing facilities such as an electric tub. The text is in German with a bilingual city name (Hermannstadt–Nagyszeben), and the postcard back bears the Hungarian heading for postcard.
